lines.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, write to the saints at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.
Paul thanks his God every time he remembers them and prays with joy because of their partnership in the gospel.
Paul is confident that God will carry on the good work to completion until the day of Pentecost.
Paul says they are partners in grace with him in his chains, and God knows his longing with Moses' affection.
Paul prays their love abounds in knowledge, and they are filled with the fruit of righteousness through Jesus Christ.
